entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.8.1
entry.summary: ## Omni Sampler 1.8.1 ### New - **Korg Wavestation**: EX waves, all-data dumps, multi-bank files, split cards and VS single-cycle waves. - **Wavetables**: Surge/Bitwig `.wt` and chunkless WAV wavetables (Serum, WaveEdit). - **Ensoniq SD-1 / VFX-SD**: SysEx programs, played from the instrument's wave ROMs. - **Gen2 support**: a new `aarch64` build for 64-bit MPCs (MPC Live III, MPC XL and kin). entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.8.0
entry.summary: See README for the 1.8.0 changes: Korg M1 / M1R / M1EX SysEx played from the M1 sample ROM dumps or Korg's M1 disk (programs, combinations, drum kits, all-data dumps, Plus+1 card), Korg TRITON content dumps and TRINITY banks, Trinity/Triton KMP/KSF/KSC, Ensoniq EPS/ASR disks, Yamaha Motif/Montage libraries, Logic EXS24, BIN/CUE images, FX page, browser groups and faster loading of big folders. Tested on MPC Live II.

entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.7.3
entry.summary: See README for the 1.7.3 changes: row scroll, per-slot key shift, wrapped SELECTED box, Reason NN-XT, Roland S-700/MV-8000, Maschine kits and more. Tested on MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.9.1.

entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.6.0
entry.summary: Omni Sampler 1.6.0: a multi-format sampler for MPC OS standalone (MPC Live/One/X/Key, Force; armv7). **New in 1.6** - **PANIC** button (top right, on every page): one tap silences every sound within 5 ms and clears anything still held (keys, sustain pedal, the screen pads, pitch bend, mod wheel). Use it if a note ever hangs. **Fix** - Hanging notes: a note-off that arrived on a different MIDI channel than its note-on was ignored, so looped sounds (strings, pads) could ring forever. entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.5.0
entry.summary: Omni Sampler 1.5.0: a multi-format sampler for MPC OS standalone (MPC Live/One/X/Key, Force; armv7). **New in 1.5** - **SAVE PATCH** (LAYERS page): saves every loaded instrument (slots A-D) as one patch in the Plugin Library's `Patches` folder, with the slot key ranges, volume, transpose and mute, the layer/keyswitch mode and your sound settings. Tap a `.omnipatch` on BROWSE to load the whole setup back. Patches keep working even when the original SF2, Kontakt file or disk image is gone. - Nero

entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.4.0
entry.summary: Omni Sampler 1.4.0: a multi-format sampler for MPC OS standalone (MPC Live/One/X/Key, Force; armv7). **New in 1.4** - LAYERS page: up to four instruments at once (slots A-D) with key ranges, volume, tune and mute; Layer or Keyswitch mode, Auto Split, and a keyboard map of the ranges. - Waveform and key-range display on PLAY. - Auto Loop (SETUP): finds sustain loops for samples that have none. - SAVE TO LIBRARY stores your sound settings in the instrument; they come back when it loads. - Plugin L
